photos.c: CENTRE: The leaders at 2½ miles. Batty, Briault and Johnston lead from Craig, Strong, Turner and Fowler with Don Taylor and Montague partly hidden. Heatley (the winner) and Bullivant complete the leading group. Gerry North, Simpson and Kilby lead the following bunch.
FRONTISPIECE (Photo Ed Lacey) The Southern field after 400 yards with Black, the Norths and Thresher prominent on the right. Batty (887) was the winner.
